name: Yasuzuka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yasuzuka town emblem in orange: a ring with three pointed rays enclosing a ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Yasuzuka in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1965.

features.role: Yasuzuka town emblem — a ring with three pointed rays enclosing a ring
